content.title: Forgot something for Easter? These stores in central Pa. are open today
content.text: Life & CultureWalmart is among the grocery stores open for the Easter holiday. (AP Photo/Gene J. Puskar, file)APBy Kaylyn Greene | kgreene@pennlive.comEaster is today, and many retailers have adjusted operating hours for the holiday.The Christian holiday commemorates the resurrection of Jesus after his death at Calvary. This year, the holiday falls on Sunday, April 5. Following is a list of what you can expect to be open or closed in case you need to pick up something. Note that some of these stores and offices are typically closed on Sundays, and would be closed regardless of the holiday.The Easter bunny was at Capital City Mall, here in 2024. The mall is closed today.
